title: Soul Forge: Spirit Binding Ritual
description: A mystical forge scene where the LeePerrySmith head serves as a stone guardian idol and the DragonDispersion model is a spectral dragon spirit. The user must channel energy between five elemental runes arranged around the head, bind the dragon spirit to the idol through a multi-step ritual, and balance a conservation-based energy system where total spiritual energy remains constant across all runes. Undo/redo support lets the user reverse ritual steps.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 with GLTFLoader and OrbitControls from CDN. Load LeePerrySmith.glb centered at origin scaled to fit view as a stone idol, and DragonDispersion.glb floating above it scaled to 30% size, slowly orbiting the head. Use a dark scene with ambient light (0x1a0a2e) and a point light on the head. Place 5 clickable glowing sphere runes in a pentagon around the head at y=0, each a different color (red, blue, green, gold, purple) representing elements. Each rune has an energy level 0-100, total energy across all runes is conserved at 250 (each starts at 50). Interactions: (1) Click a rune to select it (outline glow). (2) Use a slider or mouse-wheel on selected rune to increase its energy, which proportionally decreases others to conserve total=250. (3) When any rune reaches 100, it emits a beam (line geometry) toward the idol head. (4) When exactly 3 runes emit beams simultaneously, the dragon descends and a binding particle vortex appears between dragon and head using a Points system. (5) User clicks a Bind button to lock current state as a ritual step. (6) Implement undo/redo buttons that push/pop rune energy states onto a history stack, restoring visual states. (7) After completing 3 separate bind steps with different 3-rune combinations, the dragon merges into the head with a flash, the head material shifts to an emissive dragon-scale shader using MeshStandardMaterial with emissive map, and a completion banner appears. The dragon orbit speed should couple to total variance of rune energies. Display current energy values as HTML overlay labels near each rune using CSS2DRenderer. OrbitControls for camera. Add fog for atmosphere. All interactions must preserve the energy conservation law.
